body.name: observed-law optimal-value minimax mean-squared error
body.construction: \(\mathfrak R_{n,d,\epsilon}:=\inf_{\widehat V}\sup_{\mathbb P\in\mathcal D_{d,\epsilon}^{\mathrm{obs}}}E_{\mathbb P}[(\widehat V(O_1,\ldots,O_n)-\Psi(\mathbb P))^2]\), where the infimum is over all measurable maps from \(([d]\times\{0,1\}^2)^n\) to \(\mathbb R\).
